name: us-dependent-care-credit-2441
description: Work out the 2026 US child and dependent care credit on Form 2441 and the employer dependent care assistance exclusion under section 129, after the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. Covers qualifying persons, work-related expenses, the USD 3,000 and USD 6,000 expense limits, the new 50% top credit rate with its two-step phase-down to 35% and then 20%, the earned income limit, the USD 7,500 (USD 3,750 married filing separately) exclusion for dependent care FSAs and employer plans, and how excluded benefits reduce the credit. Trigger on "Form 2441", "child care credit", "dependent care credit", "daycare tax credit", "dependent care FSA", "DCAP", "box 10 W-2". Federal only.
